title: Lead Full Stack - AI Engineer (Relocation to Qatar)
description: We are seeking a Lead Full Stack AI Engineer to join our team with eventual relocation to Qatar. EPAM is renowned for delivering cutting-edge technological solutions to transform businesses worldwide. This is an on-site position in Qatar, requiring 3 days per week to be worked at the client's office, and the rest to be worked from anywhere in Qatar. Please only apply if you are willing to relocate to Qatar (and you are eligible). Relocation is supported by the project. Responsibilities Contribute to pragmatic AI architectures (RAG/agents/copilots/automation) integrated into cloud-native microservices and enterprise data platforms Support decisions on when to use RAG vs agents vs conventional approaches Implement and apply spec-driven development (SDD) specs/templates and support governance/quality gates Embed SDD into delivery workflows Build and maintain agentic use cases, including the ability to run/write agents and implement guardrails defined by the program Deliver production solutions (LLM integrations, retrieval, embeddings/vector stores where relevant) and examples across squads Implement responsible AI controls, data handling constraints, and agent guardrails in line with the client's policies and engineering standards Requirements 5+ years of hands-on development experience in Core Java, Spring/Spring Boot, web services, and microservices Understanding of cloud-native architecture, database concepts (Oracle/PL/SQL preferred), Kafka, and GitLab 1-2+ years of hands-on delivery exposure to LLMs, RAG, and agentic systems (production or strong pilot/enterprise PoC experience) Understanding of AI concepts, especially Spec Driven Development (SDD), including working knowledge of running and writing agents and implementing guardrails Experience with LLM providers and/or self-hosted models, prompt engineering, and an evaluation/testing mindset Familiarity with Azure, including AKS and/or Azure Web Apps, and CI/CD with GitLab (Azure DevOps a plus) Strong communication skills and ability to work in a global team Practical experience applying SDD (spec-driven ways of working) in a team setting Hands-on experience building and integrating agentic and/or RAG capabilities into real engineering workflows Ability to balance cost, productivity, quality, and risk when implementing LLM/agentic solutions Production mindset, including testing, observability, safe rollout, and secure-by-design implementation Nice to have Knowledge of React We offer Private healthcare and life insurance End of service gratuity Annual air travel tickets for expatriates Corporate Programs including Employee Referral Program with rewards Learning and development opportunities including in-house training and coaching, professional certifications, and courses

title: Senior Software Engineer – Digital Banking Backend Platforms
description: About Us ColendiBank is Türkiye's first AI-powered digital native universal deposit bank, pioneering the integration of advanced technology with accessible financial services. Officially launched in 2024 following the acquisition of a coveted digital banking license, the bank caters to individuals and SMEs with a focus on micro credit and innovative deposit services. As a fully digital institution, ColendiBank leverages a cutting-edge, scalable core banking platform to deliver seamless, secure, and user-friendly experiences. Its commitment to innovation positions it as a leader in redefining digital banking in Türkiye. Job Description We are seeking Senior Java Developers to join our backend engineering team and develop scalable backend systems for ColendiBank’s digital banking platform. Our team is responsible for building and maintaining the backend services positioned between mobile banking channels and core banking systems, focusing on seamless orchestration, integration, security, and customer-facing banking experiences. We are looking for experienced developers with strong backend engineering expertise in: Java & Spring Boot development API Gateway & BFF implementations Backend integrations and orchestration Authentication and security flows High-volume transactional systems Key Responsibilities Develop scalable and high-performance backend services using Java and Spring Boot Design and maintain microservices and RESTful APIs Contribute to API Gateway and BFF (Backend for Frontend) architectures and implementations Work on authentication, routing, orchestration, security, and integration patterns across digital banking channels Collaborate with mobile, product, and core banking teams to deliver reliable banking services Improve system performance, resiliency, and maintainability What We're Looking For Strong hands-on experience in Java and Spring Boot Experience with microservices architecture and RESTful APIs Solid knowledge of API Gateway and BFF concepts and implementations Experience in high-volume transactional systems Strong understanding of backend architecture and system integrations PostgreSQL knowledge is required Oracle experience is a plus Join Us At ColendiBank, you'll be at the forefront of creating a digital bank that delivers unparalleled customer experience. We offer opportunities for professional growth and the chance to be part of a committed team aiming to make a difference in the digital banking landscape. Embark on this transformative journey with us. Apply now to become a key player in our growing core team. ColendiBank is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (.Net/Vue.js)
description: 📌 Biz Kimiz? Kafein Teknoloji, 2005 yılından bu yana teknoloji, bankacılık, telekomünikasyon, turizm, hizmet, perakende ve sigortacılık sektörlerinde ulusal ve global müşterilerinin yazılım ve teknoloji yönetimi ihtiyaçlarına yönelik hizmet, çözüm ve ürünler sunmaktadır. Mobil ödeme sistemleri, e-ticaret ve telekomünikasyon gibi sektörlerdeki projelerinin yanı sıra, büyük veri analizi, KVKK uyumluluğu, siber güvenlik ve mobil uygulama geliştirme alanındaki projeleri, Türkiye'nin önde gelen kurumlarında ve çeşitli ülkelerde başarıyla uygulanmaktadır. Kafein Teknoloji, sunduğu hizmet ve çözümlerin yanı sıra, global iş ortakları ve teknoloji geliştirme bölgesi olan teknopark içerisinde yürüttüğü Ar-Ge projeleriyle sektörde yenilikçi çözümler üretmeye devam etmektedir. Müşteri ihtiyaçlarına yönelik zengin ürün portföyüyle Kafein Teknoloji, veri yönetişimi ve güvenliği alanında rekabet avantajı sağlayan ürünler geliştirmektedir. Akıllı veri kullanımıyla daha verimli test süreçleri sunan TDM, veri tabanı etkinliğini izleme ve önlemeye yönelik Dataskope, kullanıcı dostu veri yönetimi aracı Data Touch ve hassas verilerin korunmasına yönelik veri yönetişimi çözümü Data Focus, Kafein Teknoloji’nin yenilikçi ürünlerden sadece birkaçıdır. Teknoloji sektöründeki yenilikleri yakından takip eden ve bu alandaki yeniliklere odaklanan Kafein Teknoloji, siber güvenlik alanındaki All-in Cyber ve bulut bilişim alanındaki All-in Cloud markaları ile müşterilerinin ihtiyaçlarına yönelik kapsamlı hizmet ve çözümler sunmaktadır. Siber güvenlik çözümleri markası All-in Cyber süreç, insan ve teknolojiyi birleştirerek, kurumların bilgi güvenliği seviyesini yükseltmekte ve siber saldırılara karşı etkili bir güvenlik çemberi oluşturmaktadır. Kafein Teknoloji’nin Google Cloud ile olan stratejik ortaklığı sonucu kurulan All-in Cloud, müşterilerin büyüme, inovasyon ve dijital dönüşüm süreçlerine destek olmak için bulut teknolojilerini erişilebilir hale getirmekte ve yenilikçi bulut teknolojileri sunmaktadır. Kafein Teknoloji sunduğu hizmet, çözüm ve ürünlerin yelpazesini büyütmek konusunda iştiraklerinden de faydalanmaktadır. Bu doğrultuda, siber güvenlik alanında başarılı bir ürün portföyüne sahip olan Karmasis ve Apifort Yazılım, Kafein Teknoloji’nin iştirakleri arasında yer almaktadır. Kafein Teknoloji, halka açılan Türkiye’nin 15. bilişim şirketi olarak, 2018-2023 döneminde konsolidede yıllık ortalama %70 büyüme oranına ulaşmıştır. 750 kişilik ekibi, global müşterileri ve iş ortaklarıyla birlikte kalite ve memnuniyet odaklı yenilikçi vizyonunu sürdürmekte ve sektörün öncü şirketleri arasındaki yerini güçlendirmeye devam etmektedir. 🎯 Genel Nitelikler ve İş Tanımı Üniversitelerin Bilgisayar Mühendisliği vb. bölümlerinden mezun, Min. 5 yıl iş tecrübeli, Yüksek trafik kaldırabilen uygulamalarda (e-ticaret vb.) çalışma deneyimine sahip, C# ve .NET Core konularında ileri düzey uzmanlığa sahip (zorunlu), ASP.NET Core web framework deneyimi bulunan, MySQL, PostgreSQL ve MongoDB gibi veritabanı sistemleriyle çalışmış, RESTful API ve GraphQL deneyimi bulunan, HTML, CSS ve JavaScript konularında ileri düzey bilgi sahibi, Vue.js ile güçlü deneyime sahip (zorunlu), Tercihen React veya Angular bilgisi bulunan, Single Page Application (SPA) geliştirme deneyimine sahip, UI/UX prensipleri ve responsive web tasarımı konusunda bilgili, Jest, Mocha, Chai vb. test araçlarıyla çalışma deneyimi bulunan, Güvenli kod geliştirme ve OWASP prensipleri konusunda bilgi sahibi, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD veya benzeri araçlarla CI/CD süreçlerinde deneyimli, Yapay zeka destekli geliştirme araçlarını günlük iş akışında etkin şekilde kullanabilen, Claude'u kod üretimi, hata ayıklama, refactoring ve dokümantasyon süreçlerinde etkin şekilde kullanabilen, Etkili prompt yazma (prompt engineering) becerisine sahip, Yapay zeka çıktılarını eleştirel şekilde değerlendirebilen ve üretim koduna güvenli biçimde entegre edebilen. 🌟 Neden Biz? Kurumsal ve dinamik bir yapı Hibrit çalışma modeli Kapsamlı eğitim ve gelişim imkanları Teknolojiye yön veren, öğrenmeye açık bir ekip Teknolojiye yatırım yapan bir kültür Ar-Ge ve inovasyon odaklı projeler Takım ruhuna önem veren, kapsayıcı bir çalışma kültürü Sosyal etkinlikler ve iç iletişim faaliyetleri 🚀 Bize Katılın ve Geleceği Birlikte Şekillendirelim! 🔐 KVKK Aydınlatma Metni Başvurunuz sırasında bizimle paylaşacağınız kişisel verileriniz, 6698 sayılı Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu (KVKK) kapsamında yalnızca başvuru değerlendirme ve işe alım süreçlerinin yürütülmesi amacıyla Kafein Yazılım Hizmetleri Tic. A.Ş. tarafından işlenecek ve gerekli güvenlik önlemleri alınarak saklanacaktır. Bu işe başvurarak, özgeçmişinizin veri tabanımızda yer almasını kabul etmiş olduğunuzu bildirmek isteriz. Detaylı bilgiye KVKK Aydınlatma Metnimizden (https://www.kafein.com.tr/kvkk) ulaşabilirsiniz.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description: About The Company Scrambly is one of the fastest-growing adtech startups in the world, featured in the AppsFlyer Performance Index and Singular ROI Index in just 3.5 years. We’re growing 250%+ YoY across revenue, team, product, and technology — fully bootstrapped and profitable. We’re building the future of app discovery: a reward-powered alternative to the App Store and Google Play. Our loyalty-driven ecosystem connects millions of users with the world’s top apps and delivers unmatched, ROI-focused growth for mobile advertisers. Our mission is to build a true alternative to traditional app stores — fueled by rewards and data — and create a new, performance-first growth engine for mobile app advertisers. About The Role We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the team building the core systems behind Scrambly. In this role, you will work across two key areas: user-facing product systems - solving complex scalability challenges for a platform serving millions of users globally, - and the internal platform, covering admin systems, tooling, and back-office automation that power our operations team. Your focus will be on writing robust, high-performance code and bridging the gap between product requirements and technical reality. You will work within a modern tech stack to ensure our systems remain fast, reliable, and easy to maintain as we grow. Key Responsibilities Architecture & Development: Design, build, and maintain highly scalable Node.js (NestJS) RESTful APIs and distributed systems. Ensure seamless frontend integration and drive long-term architectural improvements. Quality & Mentorship: Champion clean, testable code standards and foster a culture of technical curiosity by mentoring engineers through code reviews and pair programming. Infrastructure & Performance: Monitor system reliability, resolve bottlenecks, manage containerized application lifecycles, and partner with DevOps to optimize CI/CD pipelines. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Design, and QA to translate requirements into robust technical specs, while clearly communicating technical constraints to non-technical stakeholders. Requirements Experience: 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong focus on Node.js and modern frameworks like NestJS. System Design: Excellent system design skills and a solid understanding of backend architecture, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems. Infrastructure: Experience with cloud platforms (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable), containerization (Docker), and orchestration/IaC (Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm). Databases & Messaging: Proficiency with relational (e.g., PostgreSQL), NoSQL (e.g., Redis) databases, and message queues (e.g., RabbitMQ, GCP Pub/Sub, Redis Pub/Sub). Frontend Autonomy: Hands-on experience with React, capable of implementing basic UI features for internal tools independently. Collaboration: Strong communication and collaboration skills, comfortable working in a fast-paced team environment. English: Upper-Intermediate or higher (B2/B2+, written and spoken). You need to be able to communicate clearly in English to work effectively in an international team and participate in architectural discussions Nice to Have Scale: Experience in a B2C startup that has scaled to millions of users. Additional Stack: Basic proficiency in Go; able to read, write, and maintain basic Go services without starting to learn from scratch. What We Offer Work on systems where performance optimizations translate to immediate user impact for millions of users. A culture of code reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship where the best idea wins. A fast-paced environment where your code quickly translates into real user value. We value the stability and value of what you ship, not just the number of lines of code. Full-time & fully remote position. 15 days of paid vacation days. 5 days of paid days off. 5 days of paid sick leave. Maternity/Paternity leave. National holidays based on the country of your stay. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

title: Video Backend Support Engineer
description: BGTS is a software and technology solutions company , powered by over 1,800 professionals . With more than 25 years of experience in digital transformation & engineering, technology consulting, and enterprise service management , we empower our clients to achieve success through a combination of engineering expertise and industry insight . We are looking for a Video Backend Support Engineer to join our client’s team and help ensure the reliability and operational continuity of their OTT video delivery platform. In this role, you will monitor live and VOD services, troubleshoot and resolve first-line incidents, and support video backend technologies across encoding, packaging, CDN delivery, and streaming. You will also work closely with engineering teams and external vendors to maintain a smooth, high-quality viewing experience, particularly during live events. Responsibilities Monitor the health and performance of TOD encoding and video delivery systems — origin, CDN, packaging, and delivery — during and around live and VOD events. Provide shift-based operational coverage aligned to the live-event calendar, ensuring services are watched during high-traffic windows. Detect, triage, and resolve first-line incidents using operational runbooks; carry out known fixes and configuration steps within defined procedures. Monitor viewer experience (QoE) and act on degradations in startup time, rebuffering, and playback errors. Escalate to engineering and to third-party vendors (Harmonic, Unified Streaming, Akamai, and others) when an issue is beyond first-line scope, and follow escalations through to resolution. Support CMS and video back-end related issues in coordination with engineering. Record all incidents in the incident reporting system, and contribute findings to post-incident reviews to prevent recurrence and improve future response. Ensure clean handover and hand-back of live systems, confirming services are fully operational before returning them to live use. Help keep runbooks, reference pages, and operational documentation current, flagging gaps to the responsible engineers. Complete assigned tasks to a high standard within agreed timeframes, coordinating with the team on planned and unplanned activities. Qualifications University degree in Electronic, Electronics & Communications, Computer, or a related engineering field. +3 years experience in broadcast systems, digital television, or OTT environments. Understanding of video standards and formats — SD/HD/UHD, MPEG-TS, HLS, DASH. Understanding of CDN-based content delivery with providers such as Akamai, CloudFront, or similar. Experience with OTT video backend systems such as Harmonic VOS360, AWS Elemental, Unified Streaming and Ateme Titan. Understanding of DRM technologies (PlayReady, Widevine, FairPlay). Experience with monitoring and QoE tools such as Conviva, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, Telestream, or TAG. Basic scripting ability (Shell, Python) for operational tasks and automation. Good understanding of the demands of a live, automated broadcast environment. Comfortable working from runbooks and following structured operational procedures. Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Experience with runbooks, PIR processes, vendor escalation, and Jira. Fluent in English; able to drive readiness across teams without direct authority. Preferred: Harmonic VOS360, Akamai, dashboarding (Grafana/ELK), SSAI/ad insertion, or live sports streaming experience. "bgts INT"
